positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed Large Batch Payouts which can do xxx-K payouts/merchant/day. Built the system using the concepts of the reactive programming paradigm, which led us to witness x-M payouts processed under 12 hours. 

- Refactored the Payouts platform (xx-M calls/day) to build next-gen delayed Payouts. This led to the foundation for features such as Dual-Control, Warehousing, and Funds-In.

- Architected the tool called Orbit to address the customer pain point of lack of visibility of Large Batch Payouts files. Spearheaded into GraphQL(first ever in Payouts) and mentored 2 interns to work on it E2E keeping security, scalability, and future extensions in design.

- Led efforts for STL reports for Venmo Payouts Pilot. Documented the steps for inner sourcing in Reporting, which have been helping the Payouts team for future efforts. Presented “Innersourcing in Action: Payouts” to Manager’s huddle forum in Chennai Office.

- Created "Declarative Test Framework" and brought DevOps best practices to the team. This resulted in a 70% reduction in the testing codebase and a faster release cycle.

- Contributed to inner sourcing in the Merchants Reporting team to unblock 40% of x-B USD worth of Payouts. 

- Found and fixed a bug of the highest severity in the PayPal Experimentation Platform.
- Found and fixed a bug in the library which powers Visual Experience on the PayPal LIVE site.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: - Developed an internal REST API in Spring Boot of maturity Level 5. Used advanced concepts of SQL like Indexing, Partitioning, and SQL Hints to serve the 99th percentile of requests under SLA.

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description: As a part of the Microsoft Campus Connect Program, worked closely with the Microsoft Global Delivery team to come up with Windows Phone App for patients having problem of epileptic Seizure using Azure Machine Learning and Azure Cloud Services.

honors.title: SPOT Award

honors.title: SPOT Award
honors.description: Recognition for leading inner-sourcing contribution in Merchant Reporting team to support Venmo Payouts for STL reports

projects.title: AFS - Andrew File System
projects.description: Created AFS using FUSE and gRPC that supports durability, crash-consistency, recovery, local caching and concurrent reads/writes

projects.title: Distributed RocksDB
projects.description: Created Distributed version of RocksDB (by Facebook - now Meta) to solve the challenges raised due to single node RocksDB.
